description: Every AnyList feature in your terminal — plus offline search, store routing, and cron-safe automations no mobile app can match.

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List all item categories (read-only). Custom category create, delete, rename, and reorder are available through the CLI mirror (categories_create / categories_delete / categories_rename / categories_reorder); category-group CRUD is unsupported. Returns array of Category.

tools.name: categories_create
tools.description: Preview or create a custom category in a shopping list with explicit apply and fresh stable-ID verification. The list and category group come from a fresh live read; the new category gets a non-conflicting stable ID and is appended after the group's current entries. Required: list and name.

params.name: list
params.description: Target list (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: category-group
params.description: Target category group (stable ID or exact name); required when the list has more than one group

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the creation; preview is the default

tools.name: categories_delete
tools.description: Preview or delete a custom category in a shopping list with explicit apply and fresh absence verification. The category is resolved by stable ID or exact name; system categories cannot be deleted and ambiguous or missing names fail closed. Required: list and category.

params.name: list
params.description: Target list (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: category
params.description: Category to delete (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the deletion; preview is the default

tools.name: categories_rename
tools.description: Preview or rename a custom category by stable ID or exact name with explicit apply and fresh stable-ID verification. The stable identifier, category group, list, and sort index are preserved. Required: list, category, and new-name.

params.name: list
params.description: Target list (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: category
params.description: Category to rename (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the rename; preview is the default

tools.name: categories_reorder
tools.description: Preview or reorder the categories of a shopping-list category group with explicit apply and fresh read-back order verification. The order must name every category in the group exactly once by stable ID or exact name; duplicates, unknown entries, and silently appended or dropped categories fail closed. Required: list and order.

params.name: list
params.description: Target list (stable ID or exact name)

params.name: category-group
params.description: Target category group (stable ID or exact name); required when the list has more than one group

params.name: order
params.description: Comma-separated order naming every category in the group exactly once, by stable ID or exact name

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the reorder; preview is the default

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a complete AnyList protobuf snapshot as JSON. Optional: output path and gzip compression; without output, writes JSON to stdout.

params.name: output
params.description: Output JSON path; omit to write to stdout

params.name: gzip
params.description: Compress output with gzip; requires output

tools.name: collections_add
tools.description: Preview adding a recipe to a collection. Live writes fail closed until collection persistence is proven. Required: collection, recipe.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the live write; omit for preview

tools.name: collections_create
tools.description: Preview creating a recipe collection. Live writes fail closed until collection persistence is proven. Required: name.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the live write; omit for preview

tools.name: collections_delete
tools.description: Preview deleting a recipe collection. Live writes fail closed until collection persistence is proven. Required: name.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the live write; omit for preview

tools.name: collections_list
tools.description: List all recipe collections. Returns array of RecipeCollection.

tools.name: collections_remove
tools.description: Preview removing a recipe from a collection. Live writes fail closed until collection persistence is proven. Required: collection, recipe.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the live write; omit for preview

tools.name: favorites_list
tools.description: List favorite items across all lists. Favorite add/remove use explicit --apply and fresh read-after-write verification. Returns array of ListItem.

tools.name: favorites_add
tools.description: Preview or add an item to a favorite list; --apply and fresh read-after-write verification are required.

params.name: list
params.description: Favorite list ID or linked shopping-list name

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the mutation; preview is the default

tools.name: favorites_remove
tools.description: Preview or remove an item from a favorite list; --apply and fresh read-after-write verification are required.

params.name: list
params.description: Favorite list ID or linked shopping-list name

params.name: item
params.description: Item name or stable item ID

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the mutation; preview is the default

tools.name: folders_create
tools.description: Create a list folder after explicit --apply and fresh read-after-write verification. Required: name.

tools.name: folders_delete
tools.description: Delete an empty list folder after explicit --apply and fresh read-after-write verification. Non-empty folders are refused. Required: name.

tools.name: folders_update
tools.description: Preview or rename/move/reorder a list folder; --apply and fresh read-after-write verification are required.

params.name: order
params.description: Comma-separated child folder/list names or IDs in desired order

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the change; preview is the default

tools.name: folders_list
tools.description: List all list folders. Create/delete, rename, parent movement, and child ordering are live-supported with fresh verification. Returns array of ListFolder.

tools.name: items_add
tools.description: Preview or create a new item on a shopping list; semantic duplicate selection is not performed. Required: list, item. Optional: quantity, notes, barcode, package_size, category, store, price, price_store, price_details, apply. All live writes require --apply and fresh live/cache read-back verification before success. Returns the new ListItem and item ID.

params.name: category
params.description: Category to assign after the base add; requires explicit apply and fresh live/cache read-back verification

params.name: barcode
params.description: UPC/EAN barcode to associate with the item

params.name: package_size
params.description: Package-size text, such as '12 count, 12 fl oz'

params.name: price
params.description: Store price to save after the base add; requires explicit apply and fresh live/cache read-back verification

params.name: price_store
params.description: AnyList store ID associated with --price; requires --price and explicit apply

params.name: price_details
params.description: Optional price note or package detail; requires --price and explicit apply

params.name: store
params.description: Store name or ID to assign after the base add; requires explicit apply and fresh live/cache read-back verification

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable category/store/price follow-up writes; preview remains the default

tools.name: items_check
tools.description: Mark one or more items as checked (bought). Required: list, item. Optional: all (default: false). Returns the new OperationResult.

params.name: all
params.description: Check all items in the list

tools.name: items_list
tools.description: List items in a shopping list. Required: list. Optional: checked (default: false), unchecked (default: false), category. Returns array of ListItem.

params.name: unchecked
params.description: Show only unchecked items (default shows all)

tools.name: items_recent
tools.description: Show recently added items across all lists. Optional: limit (default: 20). Returns array of ListItem.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return

tools.name: items_lookup
tools.description: Look up a packaged product by UPC/EAN in AnyList's read-only product catalog. Required: barcode. Returns canonical name, package size, and catalog thumbnail when available; this is not a ZIP-aware Walmart price or availability query.

tools.name: items_remove
tools.description: Remove an item from a shopping list. Required: list, item. Optional: all (default: false). Returns the new OperationResult.

tools.name: items_search
tools.description: Search for items by name across all shopping lists. Required: query. Returns array of ListItem.

tools.name: items_uncheck
tools.description: Mark one or more items as unchecked. Required: list, item. Optional: all (default: false). Returns the new OperationResult.

params.name: all
params.description: Uncheck all items in the list

tools.name: items_update
tools.description: Preview or update an existing item by stable item_id (preferred) or exact list/name lookup. Optional: name, quantity, notes, barcode, package_size, category, clear_category, store, remove_store, price, price_store, price_details, clear_price, apply. All live writes require explicit apply, fresh live read-back verification, and cache sync only after verification. Semantic candidate selection is outside the press.

params.name: item
params.description: Item name to update when item_id is not supplied

params.name: item_id
params.description: Stable AnyList item ID to update; preferred for agent workflows

params.name: package_size
params.description: New package-size text, such as '12 count, 12 fl oz'

params.name: category
params.description: Category name or ID to assign; requires explicit apply

params.name: clear_category
params.description: Clear the category match; requires explicit apply

params.name: store
params.description: Store name or ID to assign; requires explicit apply

params.name: remove_store
params.description: Store name or ID to remove; requires explicit apply

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable category/store/price live writes with fresh read-after-write verification

params.name: price
params.description: New item price; requires explicit apply

params.name: price_store
params.description: Optional store ID associated with price

params.name: clear_price
params.description: Clear one store price when price_store is supplied, or every live store-specific price when omitted; requires explicit apply

tools.name: lists_by-store
tools.description: Display a shopping list grouped by store with aisle ordering. Required: name. Returns array of StoreGroup.

tools.name: lists_create
tools.description: Create a new shopping list. Required: name. Returns the new ShoppingList.

tools.name: lists_delete
tools.description: Delete a shopping list. Required: name. Returns the new OperationResult.

tools.name: lists_rename
tools.description: Preview or rename a shopping list with explicit apply and fresh stable-ID verification. Required: name and new-name.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the rename; preview is the default

tools.name: lists_sharing_add
tools.description: Preview or invite an exact email to a shopping list; --apply is required and fresh read-back distinguishes pending from accepted.

params.name: list
params.description: List ID or exact list name

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the invite; preview is the default

tools.name: lists_list
tools.description: List all shopping lists. Rename, selected settings, notification locations, and invite-add are available through explicitly applied CLI commands with fresh verification. Returns array of ShoppingList.

tools.name: lists_reset
tools.description: Clear all checked items from a list to prepare for the next shopping trip. Required: name. Optional: keep-unchecked (default: false). Selected settings, notification locations, and invite-add are separate explicitly applied operations with fresh verification.

params.name: keep-unchecked
params.description: Keep unchecked items (default: remove checked, keep unchecked)

tools.name: lists_settings
tools.description: View cached settings for a shopping list. Selected initial-save, clear, sort-order, boolean, and notification-location writes are exposed through explicitly applied CLI commands with fresh verification. Required: name. Returns ListSettings.

tools.name: meal_add
tools.description: Preview by default or create a typed meal-calendar event with --apply; resolve IDs and verify fresh read-back before cache sync. Required with --apply: date. Optional: recipe, title, label, details, scale-factor.

params.name: scale-factor
params.description: Positive finite recipe-serving scale factor; requires recipe

params.name: apply
params.description: Explicit live-write gate; create is verified by fresh user-data read-back before cache sync

tools.name: meal_add-to-list
tools.description: Preview meal-plan ingredients; live bulk writes are disabled. Use recipes_ingredients plus explicit item operations. Required for preview: list. Optional: week (default: true), from, to, dry_run.

params.name: dry-run
params.description: Preview what would be added without writing to the list

tools.name: meal_delete
tools.description: Preview by default or delete a typed meal-calendar event with --apply; verify absence by fresh read-back before cache sync. Required with --apply: event-id.

params.name: apply
params.description: Explicit live-write gate; deletion is verified absent before cache sync

tools.name: meal_labels
tools.description: List meal plan labels (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack, etc.). Returns array of MealLabel.

tools.name: meal_show
tools.description: Show meal plan events for a date range (defaults to current week). Optional: from, to. Returns array of MealEvent.

tools.name: meal_summary
tools.description: Display the meal plan as a Mon–Sun grid with Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner labels. Optional: week (default: true), month (default: false), from. Returns the new MealSummary.

tools.name: meal_update
tools.description: Preview by default or update a typed meal-calendar event with --apply; omitted fields are preserved and fresh read-back is required. Required with --apply: event-id. Optional: date, recipe, title, label, details, scale-factor.

params.name: scale-factor
params.description: Positive finite recipe-serving scale factor; omitted preserves the existing value

params.name: apply
params.description: Explicit live-write gate; updated fields are verified before cache sync

tools.name: recipes_add-to-list
tools.description: Deprecated bulk recipe-to-list command; it fails closed. Use recipes_ingredients plus explicit AI-selected item operations instead. Required for preview: one of recipe or recipe_id, and list. Optional: scale, apply.

params.name: recipe
params.description: Recipe name; use recipe_id instead when available

params.name: recipe_id
params.description: Stable AnyList recipe ID (preferred for agent workflows); provide recipe or recipe_id, not both

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale to this many servings before adding (0 = use recipe default)

params.name: apply
params.description: Explicit live-write gate; without apply the command only previews the operation

tools.name: recipes_batch-add
tools.description: Deprecated bulk multi-recipe add; it fails closed. Use recipes_ingredients plus explicit AI-selected item operations instead. Required for preview: list, recipes.

tools.name: recipes_create
tools.description: Create a new recipe. Required: name. Optional: source-url, servings (default: 4), prep-time (plus 2 more). Returns the new Recipe.

tools.name: recipes_ingredients
tools.description: Show raw recipe ingredients and shopping-list candidate facts (read-only). Required: at least one recipe name or recipe_id. Optional: --list for target list candidates, --scale for serving count. Returns recipes with ingredients and optional candidate list items.

params.name: name
params.description: Recipe name (can be specified multiple times; use recipe_id when available)

params.name: recipe_id
params.description: Stable AnyList recipe ID (can be specified multiple times; preferred for agent workflows)

params.name: list
params.description: Target shopping-list name to fetch candidates from

params.name: scale
params.description: Target number of servings (scales ingredient quantities)

tools.name: recipes_delete
tools.description: Delete a recipe. Required: name. Returns the new OperationResult.

tools.name: recipes_filter
tools.description: Filter recipes by prep time, rating, servings, and collection. Optional: max-prep, max-cook, min-rating (plus 2 more). Returns array of Recipe.

tools.name: recipes_import
tools.description: Import a recipe from a URL. Required: url. Optional: add-to-list, scale (default: 0). Returns the new Recipe.

params.name: add-to-list
params.description: Add recipe ingredients to this list after import

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale to this many servings (0 = no scaling)

tools.name: recipes_import_paprika
tools.description: Preview or apply gzip-compressed Paprika recipe archives/files. Required: input. Preview is the safe default; --apply is required before AnyList writes. Optional: update-existing.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the validated import; preview is the default

params.name: update-existing
params.description: Update matching recipes instead of skipping them

tools.name: recipes_photo_attach
tools.description: Preview a validated recipe image offline or upload and attach it with explicit apply. Required: name, file. The recipe is read back by ID after save and verified photo IDs are persisted in the local cache.

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live upload and save; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_photo_clear
tools.description: Preview or remove one recipe photo, or all photos when photo_id is omitted. Explicit apply and fresh live read-back verification are required; verified photo IDs are persisted in the local cache.

params.name: photo-id
params.description: Remove only this photo; omit to remove all photos

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live recipe save; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_update
tools.description: Preview selected fields of an existing recipe by default without clearing omitted fields. One selector is required for apply: name or recipe. Optional: new-name, source-name, source-url, note, nutrition, servings, prep-time, cook-time, rating, and stdin-only ingredients/preparation_steps arrays. Pass apply=true or --apply to enable the typed save-recipe write, fresh read-back verification, and cache sync; use recipes_photo_attach or recipes_photo_clear for photo changes.

params.name: recipe
params.description: Alternative existing recipe selector (--recipe or stdin JSON)

params.name: ingredients
params.description: Stdin-only replacement array of ingredient strings or objects

params.name: preparation_steps
params.description: Stdin-only replacement array of preparation-step strings

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live recipe save and fresh read-after-write verification; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_link
tools.description: Show a cached recipe's source URL (read-only local operation). Required: name.

tools.name: recipes_sharing_list
tools.description: List pending recipe-link requests, requests awaiting confirmation, and linked users from fresh AnyList user data.

tools.name: recipes_sharing_request
tools.description: Preview or explicitly request recipe sharing with an exact email address. Required: email. Preview is the default; --apply is required and the pending request is verified by fresh read-back.

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live request; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_sharing_cancel
tools.description: Preview or explicitly cancel a pending recipe-link request by exact ID or confirming email. One selector is required; --apply is required and absence is verified.

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live cancellation; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_sharing_accept
tools.description: Preview or explicitly accept an incoming recipe-link request by exact ID. --apply is required and linked-user presence is verified.

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live acceptance; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_sharing_unlink
tools.description: Preview or explicitly unlink a linked recipe-sharing user by exact user ID or email. One selector is required; --apply is required and absence is verified.

params.name: apply
params.description: Enable the live unlink; preview is the default

tools.name: recipes_list
tools.description: List all recipes (read-only). Use the separate verified recipe-sharing endpoints for link requests and linked users. Optional: limit (default: 0). Returns array of Recipe.

tools.name: recipes_missing
tools.description: Show which recipe ingredients are not already on a shopping list. Required: recipe, list. Returns array of Ingredient.

tools.name: recipes_scale
tools.description: Scale a recipe's ingredient quantities to a target serving count. Required: name, servings. Returns the new Recipe.

tools.name: recipes_search
tools.description: Search recipes by name or ingredient (uses local SQLite cache). Required: query. Optional: ingredient (default: false). Returns array of Recipe.

params.name: ingredient
params.description: Search by ingredient name instead of recipe name

tools.name: recipes_show
tools.description: Show full recipe details including ingredients and preparation steps. Required: name. Optional: ingredients-only (default: false). Returns the new Recipe.

tools.name: starters_list
tools.description: List starter list items. Starter add/remove use explicit --apply and fresh read-after-write verification. Returns array of ListItem.

tools.name: starters_add
tools.description: Preview or add an item to a user starter list; --apply and fresh read-after-write verification are required.

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the mutation; preview is the default

tools.name: starters_remove
tools.description: Preview or remove an item from a user starter list; --apply and fresh read-after-write verification are required.

params.name: item
params.description: Item name or stable item ID

params.name: apply
params.description: Apply the mutation; preview is the default

tools.name: stores_list
tools.description: List all stores and store filters (read-only; store/filter writes are unsupported). AnyList does not provide a ZIP-aware Walmart price or availability query. Returns array of Store.
